item.title: Singer-songwriter Swan Porter soars to new musical heights
item.description: Singer-songwriter Swan Porter will be returning for the next Legends: Live and Local concert Feb. 27 in which she and local rock band Trestles will be joining a pair of goth pioneers: Bauhaus and Love and Rockets bassist David J; and Lol Tolhurst, the original drummer for The Cure who became the band's keyboardist for much of their '80s output.

item.title: A funeral home stashed 189 decaying bodies and handed out fake ashes. His mother was among them
item.description: The funeral home owners gave families fake ashes for years, trying to conceal the bodies.

item.title: Santa Cruz County RTC formally ends contract with rail operator
item.description: The Santa Cruz County Regional Transportation Commission formally terminated its contract with its designated rail operator despite past threats of reciprocal litigation and, separately, procedural concerns from some members of the public.
